sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName, avg(if(d.CalendarDayOfWeekNumber IN (1,7), daily.SalesAmount, NULL)) AS AvgWeekend, avg(if(d.CalendarDayOfWeekNumber NOT IN (1,7), daily.SalesAmount, NULL)) AS AvgWeekday, AvgWeekend - AvgWeekday AS AbsoluteDifference, (AvgWeekend - AvgWeekday) / AvgWeekday AS RelativeDifference FROM (SELECT f.DateKey AS DateKey, pc.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount FROM retail.FactSales f INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY f.DateKey, pc.ProductCategoryKey) AS daily INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON daily.DateKey = d.DateKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON daily.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY RelativeDifference DESC
